expression.original: An axiom audit certifies a pair — proof and toolchain — not a proof. The same unchanged proof text has different axiom footprints under different kernels, so a repository that pins a toolchain and reports an audit is reporting a fact about that pin. Re-pinning is not neutral maintenance.

grounding.result: measured: Field.history_preserved is axiom-free under Lean 4.22.0 and depends on propext under Lean 4.9.0, the pinned CI toolchain. Nothing in the proof changed.
